series_start_reason: 2002Q3 is the first quarter whose own release prints a net product sales table: the Q3 2002 Merck release prints both a gross table (Singulair 380) and a net table (350), and every later release uses the net table. Merck releases from Q3 2000 to Q2 2002 print a single 'Product Sales Detail' table (Q3 2000 235, Q4 2000 245, Q1 2001 300, Q2 2001 375, Q3 2001 350, Q4 2001 350, Q1 2002 470, Q2 2002 250; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/64978/000095012300009578/y41577ex99-b.txt and the releases of 2001-01-23, 2001-04-20, 2001-07-20, 2001-10-18, 2002-01-22, 2002-04-18, 2002-07-19); the Q3 2001 figure 350 matches the gross basis (380 / 1.09 = 349) rather than the net basis, so they are not spliced onto the net series.
notes: Each quarter is read from the issuer's own earnings release (Organon's Q2 2026 figure from its Form 10-Q: the Q2 2026 release exhibit prints no Singulair row). Merck's rows are the Total column of the Singulair line; 2002Q3 and 2002Q4 are rounded to the nearest $5 million as the tables state. Merck's Q1 2021 release (2021-04-29) prints 107; Organon's own Q1 2021 10-Q (filed 2021-06-21) prints the same 107, so the two issuers' lines are the same scope. Annual cross-checks against the full-year figure printed in each Q4 document: 2004 2,623 vs 2,622; 2005 2,976 vs 2,976; 2006 3,579; 2007 4,266; 2008 4,337; 2009 4,659 vs 4,660; 2010 4,987; 2011 5,479; 2012 3,853; 2013 1,196; 2014 1,092; 2015 931; 2016 915; 2017 732; 2018 708; 2019 698; 2020 461 vs 462; 2022 411; 2023 405 vs 404; 2024 360 vs 359; 2025 252, all matching within rounding. 2021 sums to 412 (Merck Q1 107 plus Organon Q2 to Q4 305) against 413 printed in Organon's 10-K. 2003 sums to 2,024 while the Q4 2003 release prints 2,009: the Q3 2003 release implies the first-half figure was restated downward (nine months 1,502 less third quarter 616 gives 886, against 474 + 427 = 901 printed in the first two quarters' own releases), and the quarters are kept as first printed. 2002 is a partial year (Q3 and Q4 only). Singulair lost U.S. exclusivity in August 2012 (Q3 2012 602 vs Q3 2011 1,336, U.S. column 249 vs 901 in the Q3 2012 release).
search_log: Merck & Co. (CIK 64978, to 2009): opened every 8-K exhibit filed in the earnings windows (mid-January to mid-February, April to early May, July to early August, October to early November) from 1998 to 2010 and the primary documents of every 10-Q and 10-K; the first document with a Singulair product sales table is the 2000-10-20 release (exhibit 99(b)); earlier 10-Qs (to Q2 2000) mention Singulair in prose only with no figure; EX-13 annual report exhibits were not scanned

Merck & Co. (CIK 310158, formerly Schering-Plough, issuer after the Nov 2009 merger): scanned 8-K exhibits in the same windows from 2009 to 2021; the Q4 2009 release (filed 2010-02-16, outside the first window) was found by listing 8-Ks for Jan to Apr 2010; the Singulair row of exhibit 99.2 (Total, U.S., international columns) gives the quarter
Schering-Plough releases before the merger mention Singulair only as the MSP partnership product and print no Singulair sales; not used

Organon & Co. (CIK 1821825): listed 8-K, 10-Q and 10-K; earnings release exhibits 99.1 from Q2 2021 to Q1 2026 carry a Singulair row (U.S., Non-U.S., Total); the 2026-07-31 8-K exhibit prints no Singulair row, so Q2 2026 comes from the 10-Q filed 2026-07-31
the net product sales detail exhibit was identified by its title in each release; the 2002-10-18 release prints gross and net tables, the net row was selected by value
